response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), shares AS (SELECT ID, examination_count, 1.0 * examination_count / SUM(examination_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts), margins AS (SELECT ID, examination_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average_share FROM shares) SELECT ID, examination_count, share, above_average_share FROM margins WHERE above_average_share > 0 ORDER BY above_average_share DESC, ID LIMIT 10;
